.kitchen
Phrut krim resipi | phrut mus - koee jiletin kastard mus | vistrit photo aur vidiyo nuskha ke sath phal kastard musa. mishrit phal, kastard aur krim ke sath banaya gaya ek behad saral aur svadisht phal-aadharit mithaee nuskha. masaledar bhojan ke bad parose jane vale kisi bhi chhote ya bare avsar ke lie aadarsh ek utkrisht malaeedar mithaee nuskha. mul rup se, mus vyanjnon ko aam taur par jiletin ya yahan tak ki ande jaise kritrim yaugikon ke sath taiyar kiya jata hai, lekin yah kastard paudar ke sath taiyar kiya jata hai.
